Title: Weekend in the hills
Date: 2026-11-05
Type: Journal
Collection: Personal
Author: Alex Morgan

Today I walked the Pine Ridge trail with Sam Chen. We brought a thermos of coffee and stopped at the wooden lookout. The weather stayed clear, although the upper path was muddy.

Sam and I talked about returning in spring when more of the trail opens. We did not choose a date or make a booking. I should keep that distinction in my notes so a possible trip does not become a confirmed event.

The walk reminded me to leave space between tasks. This was a personal outing, not a Studio project meeting, even though Sam is also involved in that project.
